verdict.rationale: Zulip's docs say many conversations can run in the same channel at once, each in its own named topic, and that new topics can be started from anywhere. Subscribed channels feed an inbox and a recent-conversations view, which supports catching up. Community users repeatedly describe the topic model as what keeps busy channels manageable without being overwhelmed, though some say non-technical users find it confusing. Missing for 10: detailed first-party documentation of the catch-up workflow (inbox and recent conversations are mentioned only in passing), and evidence that every message is required to have a topic (the docs only say you 'should' start one).
